### TC.Tuple

This packed transient argument tuple is not a dense Data array when it contains nil.

### [integer]

One-based nonnil value at that position. Holes represent nil.

```text
TC.GuestValue
```

### n

Exact number of positions, including trailing nil.

```text
integer
```
